title: Drunk Wife Murdered Husband Outside Dollar General Store
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation into the death of a 49-year-old Illinois man. Deputies with the Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office found Melissa Howes hysterical in the Dollar General parking lot. Authorities spoke with witnesses who explained what went on between Melissa and her husband before both of them were taken to nearby hospitals. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
